title: Money to place put in Free to spend counts again; kept in Waiting on purpose it does not; a period-end answer record's moves fill a place (decisions R1, P2 and the Q watch item)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 150,000, of which 100,000 is kept for a trip and 20,000 is what is left of Free to spend (typed). An emergency place starts empty. Pay of 250,000 lands on the 25th (moved earlier) and starts the period; Free to spend is 40,000 a month. On Wed 6 Jan the person removes the trip: its 100,000 moves to Waiting marked "to place". On Thu 7 Jan they place 30,000 of it in Free to spend, where it counts in safe to spend again. On Fri 8 Jan they keep 20,000 of it in Waiting on purpose: it is no longer to place, and it still does not count. On Mon 25 Jan the pay is ticked, and the period-end answer for Free to spend (one record, pe:2027-01-24:free) moves 15,000 of what was left to the emergency place. Every amount is made up.

events.note: the period-end answer for Free to spend: one record holding its moves

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 20,000 (Free to spend at the opening, typed) = 20,000
asks.note: The bank's headroom is 150,000 - 100,000 (the trip's money, to place) = 50,000, above Free to spend, so Free to spend caps it.

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 20,000 (Free to spend at the opening) + 30,000 (the trip's money placed in Free to spend) = 50,000
asks.note: Placed in Free to spend, the money counts in safe to spend again [R1]: the bank's headroom is now 150,000 - 70,000 = 80,000.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 150,000 (Bank today) - 20,000 (Trip's money, kept in Waiting on purpose) - 50,000 (Trip's money, in Waiting to place: 100,000 - 30,000 - 20,000) = 80,000
asks.note: Kept in Waiting on purpose, the money is no longer to place and still does not count [R1].

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 20,000 (Free to spend at the opening) + 30,000 (placed in Free to spend) = 50,000

asks.question: place
asks.why: 0 (opening) + 15,000 (the period-end answer pe:2027-01-24:free, its move to Emergency) = 15,000
asks.note: A period-end answer is one record per place holding its moves [P2]; place balances read its moves (the Q watch item replaces the move events of SCHEMA_V3 6.2 and 7.4).
